name: vtbl
meaning: 0x574340, single entry = the scalar deleting destructor 0x40b030; written by the constructor 0x40a140 and the destructor 0x40ad97

name: width
meaning: surface width in texels (0x40a319: = desc.dwWidth, rounded up to a power of two when the device requires it); the row pitch TexScroll_Update 0x560bcc multiplies by

name: height
meaning: surface height (0x40a32b: = desc.dwHeight); the modulus of the TexScroll offset (0x560c1e)

name: format
meaning: pixel-format index passed to the constructor (its 4th argument, stored via 0x5c7aa0 at 0x40a39d, then into +0xc at 0x40a3e7); read back by 0x40ade8 in TexScroll_AddRect

name: surface
meaning: the DirectDraw surface: Lock +0x64 / Unlock +0x80 / BltFast +0x1c / Release +0x8 in the destructor

name: desc
meaning: DDSURFACEDESC2 the constructor fills (dwSize 0x7c) and creates the surface from
